summary: Verified the backend-target migration from Emergent FastAPI to the user's external Hostinger PHP+MySQL server. Confirmed .env and GitHub Actions workflow point to the new URL while protected packager vars remain untouched. Confirmed ADMIN_API_AVAILABLE gating correctly suppresses in-app admin navigation on the Hostinger host (no crash, no navigation to /admin*). Direct HTTP checks against the live external Hostinger backend confirm /ping, /public/settings, /chat, /auth/register, /credits/me, /streak/status, /history all return 200; /translate returns 502 with 'Incorrect API key provided' exactly as reported by main agent — this is the external server's own OpenAI key misconfiguration, not an app bug. Did not touch /app/backend at all per instructions. tsc/eslint re-run clean on the 3 changed frontend files.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 502 'LLM provider rejected the request: Incorrect API key provided' — confirmed exactly as described by main agent. This is a misconfigured OpenAI key in the USER'S OWN separate PHP admin panel, outside this app's control. Not a defect of this codebase; /app/backend (untouched, no longer in the request path) is unaffected.

react_native_issues.issue: On React-Native-Web, Alert.alert() is a known no-op/unsupported-platform behavior — no visible dialog/text and no browser dialog event fired when triggered via Playwright in the web preview. This is an inherent react-native-web limitation (not introduced by this change) and will show correctly as a native Alert on iOS/Android/Expo Go. The functionally critical part — NOT navigating to /admin or /admin-login when ADMIN_API_AVAILABLE is false — was verified and works correctly on web.

external_backend_connectivity.GET /api/history (guest, unauthenticated: 200, returns pre-existing seeded history items (not created by this test run, untouched)
external_backend_connectivity.POST /api/translate: 502 'Incorrect API key provided' - matches known pre-existing issue on external server, not a code defect

admin_gating.profile-screen.tsx '#about' x7 taps: No navigation to /admin or /admin-login; URL stayed at /profile-screen. PASS
admin_gating.settings/index.tsx 'About' x7 taps: No navigation to /admin or /admin-login; URL stayed at /settings. PASS

verification_results.app_load: Web preview home screen renders correctly, no red screen, no console errors beyond a pre-existing harmless 'Font.loadAsync patch failed' warning (unrelated to this change, present on every load)
verification_results.lint_typecheck: npx tsc --noEmit: 0 errors in app/profile-screen.tsx, app/settings/index.tsx, src/api/client.ts (pre-existing unrelated errors remain only in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx, app/voice-screen.tsx, src/components/StartupConsoleOverlay.tsx). npx eslint on the 3 changed files: 0 issues.

action_items: No code changes required for this task — all requested verifications passed.

Communicate to the user (not an app bug): /api/translate still returns 502 on their Hostinger server due to the OpenAI key configured in their own separate PHP admin panel; /api/chat works via APInex. This must be fixed in their admin panel, not in this codebase.

Informational only: Alert.alert() does not render visually in the web preview (react-native-web limitation) — verify the 'Admin unavailable' alert visually on a real device/Expo Go build if a visual confirmation is desired; the functional admin-navigation block is confirmed working on web.
critical_code_review_comments: ADMIN_API_AVAILABLE derivation in client.ts is clean and self-documenting (regex against BASE_URL host), avoids a hardcoded flag, and automatically re-enables admin routing if EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is ever switched back to an emergentagent.com host — good design choice.

Both profile-screen.tsx and settings/index.tsx implement the identical 7-tap-counter + ADMIN_API_AVAILABLE gate pattern; consider extracting this into a shared hook (e.g., useAdminTapGate) to avoid future drift between the two near-duplicate implementations, though this is a minor DRY nit, not a bug.
No hardcoded URLs found in the 3 changed files; BASE_URL/API_BASE correctly derive from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var only.

success_rate.backend: 100% of external-server connectivity checks returned expected results (7/8 endpoints 200, 1/8 known 502 matching reported issue)

seed_data_creation: Created one test user via POST /api/auth/register on the EXTERNAL Hostinger server: TEST_sdet_user_jan2026@example.com (not deleted — no delete-account flow exercised, external server is user-owned and outside this app's data-cleanup scope; flagging for awareness, not cleaned up since /app/backend/DB was never touched).
context_for_next_testing_agent: This iteration confirms the infra migration (Emergent FastAPI -> user's external Hostinger PHP server) is correctly wired end-to-end on the frontend: env vars, GitHub Actions workflow, and the ADMIN_API_AVAILABLE-based admin-gating all work as designed. /app/backend FastAPI code was not touched, started, or verified in this run (per explicit instruction) — it is no longer in the app's request path. The only non-PASS item is the external server's own /api/translate 502 (bad OpenAI key in their separate admin panel), which was explicitly flagged as known/out-of-scope by the main agent and is reproduced identically here.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no new bugs found. The /api/translate 502 RCA (for user communication only): Hostinger PHP server's /api/translate route calls OpenAI directly using a key configured in their own web admin panel; that key is invalid/revoked ('Incorrect API key provided'), while /api/chat uses a different provider (APInex/DeepSeek) with a valid key, hence chat works but translate doesn't. Fix must happen in the user's own Hostinger admin panel, not in this Expo app or the dormant /app/backend FastAPI service.
